summary: Photosensitive facial eruption with scaly arm plaques and hair thinning; left upper-arm biopsy performed, with topical treatments documented.
Left upper arm skin biopsy shows vacuolar interface dermatitis with increased dermal mucin; findings can be seen in cutaneous lupus erythematosus or dermatomyositis.
Urinalysis shows protein, blood, red blood cells, dysmorphic red cells and casts; creatinine and eGFR are reported as preserved.
Hematology note reports mild decreases in all three blood cell lines, elevated reticulocytes and ESR, and no blasts or schistocytes on smear.
Patient-prepared list reports four current medications: two topical creams, an oral contraceptive, and over-the-counter naproxen.
